Selected area: ≈11 um2 Wide angle camera length: 300 mm Small angle camera length: 4.6 m Environment: Not reported; Atmosphere not reported for this operation. Nominal camera lengths. Diffraction acquired by summing without drift correction. Fixed spot size/C2 excitation keeps convergence constant; small-angle stigmation adjusted for round beam. Native real-space lattice spacing calibrates small-angle camera length. MoO3 standard determines wide-angle rotation; real-space images determine small-angle rotation. general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
